title: Readings that refutations on the travel-claim battery rest on, and the criticisms of them

arguments.statement: In the round-one key, 'hotel two nights at $205.00' is a nightly rate and BND-104's total is 302000.
arguments.readiness_reason: The oracle as written for that corpus; readiness is the reading's own consistency, not its truth.

arguments.statement: In the round-one key, 'motel three nights at $142.00' is a nightly rate and TRV-004's total is 94705.
arguments.readiness_reason: The oracle as written for that corpus.

arguments.statement: 'N nights at $X' without 'a night' is ambiguous between a nightly rate and a total; all four round-one models read BND-104 as a total and the round-two key admits both readings.
arguments.readiness_reason: Identical failure across four models of three families, and the phrasing was corrected in the corpus; recorded as H13.

arguments.statement: The key reads 'two days of requirements workshops with our client' as client_visit.
arguments.readiness_reason: The oracle as written; marked interpretation_provisional in the corpus.

arguments.statement: 'Requirements workshops' can be read as training or as other; two models read it as client_visit, one as training, one as other in some variants.
arguments.readiness_reason: Not settled by a person; the models split and the instruction does not decide it.

arguments.statement: Under the month-first rival on BND-102 the key admits 3 or 92 nights and nothing else.
A model may apply the month-first rule to the departure and not the return (33 nights); whether that is a rule-following error or a reading the key should admit is open.
arguments.readiness_reason: One model did it in two rounds; not settled by a person.

arguments.statement: In rounds one and two a quoted span had to occur verbatim; a full date completed from a range was SPAN_NOT_IN_DOCUMENT.
arguments.readiness_reason: The matcher in force under that pilot configuration.

arguments.statement: The same verbatim reading under the round-two pilot configuration.
arguments.readiness_reason: The matcher in force under that pilot configuration.

arguments.statement: A full date completed from a range the document states is a fair quotation of that range; the battery later adopted this as the date_range_completion relaxation.
arguments.readiness_reason: Adopted into the configuration for round three and the sweep; a person decided it.

arguments.statement: Not every SPAN_NOT_IN_DOCUMENT in rounds one and two was a completed range: misspelt names, values written as spans, and invented places were also refused.
arguments.readiness_reason: True of some records and not others; the appraisal cannot tell them apart by trigger alone, which is why this criticism is left undecided rather than asserted.
